title: 第1章 诅咒之眼无情楚家第2章 轮回天目上古神瞳
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
“楚天铭，三天后，你将入赘青州韩家！”
天玄大陆，楚家议事大厅当中。
楚家家主楚狂，坐在虎皮大椅之上，身上穿着一件紫蟒长袍，看起来充满威严。
而数十名楚家高层，则依次而坐。
众人的目光，全部都汇聚在跪在大厅中央的布衣少年身上。
有嘲讽，有不屑，有厌恶，还有少许的同情。
那布衣少年听到楚狂的话后，浑身不禁一颤，缓缓抬起头来，一双无比苍白的眼睛，直视着前方。
秽眼！
在天玄大陆，被誉为诅咒之眼，凡是生长这种眼睛的人，皆是被上天诅咒的人，不仅无法视物，而且天生绝脉，是个无法修炼的废物。
“堂弟，恭喜你，马上就要入赘韩家，成为韩家家主的女婿了，我可是听说那位韩家大小姐，虽然长的很丑，但是性格还是不错的，与你正好是天生一对，地造一双。”
“而只要你入赘韩家，韩家就会将他们家族的宝剑永霜给我们楚家，算起来，你也是帮我一个大忙。”
旁边，堂兄楚天骄一脸得意的表情。
此话一出，大厅内传来一阵哄笑。
“楚天骄，你别做梦了，我是不会入赘韩家的！”
楚天铭攥着拳头，愤怒的回道。
“死瞎子，楚家养了你这么多年，现在自然是你回报的时候！
你没有权利拒绝，知道么？”
楚天骄不屑的笑了笑。
“养育之恩？”
楚天铭好似听到世上最好笑的笑话，仰天大笑道：“楚家如果没有我父亲和娘亲的牺牲，现在还都是天河城的九流家族！

而这些年来，你们非但不感恩，处处针对我，如今更是要借机将我赶出楚家！
现在却跟我提养育之恩，你们的脸呢？”
楚天铭越说越是激动，身体都是微微发抖，这些年来，在楚家所受的屈辱，仿佛在这一刻全部在他脑海当中一一呈现。
而旁边的楚家高层，却一个个面带讥笑，丝毫不觉得自己做错什么。
唯独堂妹楚倩微微垂首，芳颜露出了一丝愧疚之色。
“放肆！”
楚狂震怒，没想到平日里软弱可欺的楚天铭竟然敢在这里当众辱骂，厉声呵斥道：“这里是楚家的议事厅，不是你能撒野的地方！”
“老杂毛，少在这里装蒜，要不是你，我爹和我娘怎么会死，像你这种自私自利，无情无义的老东西，根本没有资格做我爷爷！
从今以后，我楚天铭和楚家再无任何瓜葛！”
楚天铭自然看不到楚狂难堪至极的脸色，不过即便看到，他也不在乎了，毕竟他已经对楚家彻底死心。
说完。
他便起身，拄着拐杖，准备离开。
content_en:
"Chu Tianming, in three days, you will marry the Han family in Qingzhou!"
Tianxuan Continent, in the Chu family meeting hall.
The head of the Chu family, Chu Kuang, was sitting on a big tiger-skin chair. He was wearing a purple python robe and looked majestic.
Dozens of senior members of the Chu family were seated one after another.
Everyone's eyes were all focused on the commoner boy kneeling in the center of the hall.
There is ridicule, disdain, disgust, and a little sympathy.
After hearing Chu Kuang's words, the commoner boy couldn't help but tremble all over. He slowly raised his head and stared straight ahead with a pair of extremely pale eyes.
Dirty eyes!
In Tianxuan Continent, it is known as the cursed eye. Anyone with such eyes is cursed by God. Not only can they not see, but they are also born with no blood vessels and are a waste that cannot be cultivated.
"Cousin, congratulations. You are about to marry into the Han family and become the son-in-law of the head of the Han family. I heard that the eldest lady of the Han family, although she is ugly, has a good personality. She is a perfect match for you."
"And as long as you marry the Han family, the Han family will give their family's sword Yongshuang to our Chu family. After all, you are doing me a big favor."
Next to him, his cousin Chu Tianjiao had a proud expression on his face.
As soon as these words came out, there was a burst of laughter in the hall.
"Chu Tianjiao, stop dreaming, I will not marry into the Han family!"
Chu Tianming clenched his fists and replied angrily.
"You blind man, the Chu family has raised you for so many years, now is the time for you to repay the favor!
You have no right to refuse, you know? "
Chu Tianjiao smiled disdainfully.
"The grace of upbringing?"
As if he had heard the funniest joke in the world, Chu Tianming looked up to the sky and laughed: "If it hadn't been for the sacrifices of my father and mother, the Chu family would still be a top-notch family in Tianhe City!
And over the years, not only have you been ungrateful, you have targeted me everywhere, and now you are even trying to take the opportunity to drive me out of the Chu family!
Now you are mentioning the kindness of raising me, where is your face? "
The more Chu Tianming talked, the more excited he became, and his body was shaking slightly. The humiliation he had suffered in the Chu family over the years seemed to be all present in his mind at this moment.
But the senior members of the Chu family next to them all had sneers on their faces, not feeling at all that they had done anything wrong.
Only my cousin Chu Qian lowered her head slightly, with a hint of guilt on her face.
"Presumptuous!"
Chu Kuang was furious. He didn't expect that Chu Tianming, who was usually weak and easy to bully, would dare to insult him in public here. He sternly scolded: "This is the meeting hall of the Chu family, not a place for you to act wild!"
"Old bastard, stop pretending here. If it weren't for you, how could my father and my mother die? A selfish, ruthless old man like you has no right to be my grandfather!
From now on, I, Chu Tianming, will have nothing to do with the Chu family! "
Chu Tianming naturally couldn't see Chu Kuang's extremely embarrassed face, but even if he saw it, he didn't care anymore. After all, he had completely given up on the Chu family.
Finished.
He stood up, leaning on his crutches, and prepared to leave.
